Backend: Express API in `backend/` (`backend/index.js`); routes: `backend/src/routes/`, controllers: `backend/src/controllers/`, repositories: `backend/src/repositories/`, switched by `RepositoryFactory` (JSON/Mongo). Menus use multer `upload.single("image")`. Frontend: React in `frontend/`, client code in `frontend/src/`; admin UI: `frontend/src/pages/admin/` (e.g. `adminhomes.jsx`); API client: `frontend/src/lib/api.js`, using fetch and `credentials: 'include'`, with automatic `FormData` detection (do not set `Content-Type` manually). Image storage is local or Cloudinary, configured via `backend/.env` (`IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_*`). JWT auth: frontend saves tokens in browser local storage; API client includes `credentials: 'include'` (always double check this).

Read first:
- `backend/src/routes/*.js`
- `backend/src/controllers/*`
- `backend/src/repositories/repository.factory.js`
- `backend/.env.examples`
- `frontend/src/lib/api.js`
- `frontend/src/pages/admin/adminhomes.jsx`

`api.js` detects `FormData`, avoids `Content-Type` so the browser adds the boundary, sends `credentials: 'include'`, and unwraps inconsistent responses.

RepositoryFactory is required for repository implementations. Cookie-first auth: never rely on localStorage tokens in production — code includes a development fallback but expects httpOnly cookies. File-upload routes require multipart/form-data; the frontend must not set `Content-Type` header explicitly when sending FormData (the client `api.js` handles this). Setting `Content-Type` manually will break boundary generation.

Tests are under `backend/src/__tests__`, using `supertest` and the app export from `backend/index.js`; tests may use repository factories for fixtures.

When running backend npm tests locally always comment out the `MONGO_URI` environment variable in the `.env` file at the `./backend` folder make sure it was not declared and just un-comment it back after testing, Also skip cloudinary test cases if at least one of the following environment variables is not set, is empty or is not present in the `.env` file: `IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME`, `CLOUDINARY_API_KEY` and `CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET`.

Commands: `cd backend && npm run dev`; `cd frontend && npm start`; `cd backend && npm test`. Inspect root `package.json`, `backend/package.json`, and `frontend/package.json`; CI: `.github/workflows/backend-ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/frontend-ci.yml`.

Prefer repository factory operations. Check storage env/config before changing image
